messages:
anja: kicking off canary for catalog enable of 'nova-7b-quant' in us-west1. change window 2026-03-22 16:00-18:00 PST. rolling targets 5% -> 25% over 30m.

deploy-bot: [deploy] start canary model-catalog/nova-7b-quant canary_id=canary-2478 stage=canary target=5% region=us-west1

leo: noted. is fallback ordering set to latency-first or cost-first?

anja: latency-first then quantized fallback. config below.

```yaml
catalog:
  model: nova-7b-quant
  fallback_order:
    - nova-7b-raw # higher perf, higher cost
    - nova-7b-int4 # cheaper quant
  rollout:
    initial: 5%
    step: 10%
    max: 25%
    per_region_overrides:
      eu-west1: 10%
``` 

marcus: safety gates: if p95 latency > 350ms OR error_rate > 1% sustained for 10m -> PAUSE and failover to fallback chain.

ops-bot: watch added: alert=ops/model-catalog/nova-7b-quant/guards contact=@oncall runbook=runbook-nova-quant

sage: if rollback is needed we should pin previous model (nova-7b-raw) at priority 100 and mark change as emergency. also notify support with template.

anja: +1. adding graceful-evict ttl=2m so in-flight requests finish before eviction.

deploy-bot: canary canary-2478 progressed: us-west1 target=25% (steady), eu-west1 target=10% (decreased)

leo: seeing small latency bump in eu-west1 tail, lowered eu rollout to 5% and started trace capture.

deploy-bot: updated per-region target: eu-west1=5%

anja: I'll open release notes PR and attach perf snapshots. if guardrail trips we'll cut traffic to fallback chain and run the rollback checklist.

marcus: confirm dashboard id dash-ops-342 and runbook link https://internal.redwood/dash/dash-ops-342 and https://internal.redwood/runbooks/nova-7b-quant-rollback

anja: confirmed. test plan and postmortem template in the PR. tagging @support for heads-up.

leo: thanks — coordinating customer comms. :thumbsup:
